SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Section 1, Special Br. Division,
REPORT
Date February 25 1938.
Subject Samuel L. Altclass.
Made by D. S. Larby Forwarded by C Crawford D I
With reference to the attached communication addressed
to the Commissioner of Police from one, Samuel L. Altclass,
this individual, who is of Jewish extraction, was born in
Warsaw, Poland, on May 13, 1915.
Within a year of his birth, Altclass was taken by his
parents to Vladivostok, where the family resided for the
duration of the Great War, subsequent to the conclusion of
which, this place of residence alternated between Harbin
and Tientsin, the latter city being the one in which Altclass
obtained his education which does not appear to be of a very
high standard.
In 1931, accompanied by his mother, brother and step-
father, Altclass left Tientsin and proceeded to Shanghai
where he has since resided. His step-father is one, Leo
Roujansky, an unemployed salesman, who is well known to the
police forces of both the International Settlement and the
French Concession as a notorious pickpocket with a number
of convictions to his credit. His brother, Boris Altclass,
formerly served in the Shanghai Volunteer Corps but resigned
some two years ago when he acquired Soviet citizenship and
returned to Russia where he is now working as a motor
mechanic in Tashkent.
In 1932, Altclass became apprenticed with the firm of
Linotype & Machinery, Ltd., 160, Avenue Edward VII, where
he has since been continuously employed; he now occupies
the position of mechanic in the engineering department at
a monthly salary of $75.00.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号。
特务科第一股，
报告
日期 1938年2月25日。
事由 塞缪尔·L·奥特拉斯（Samuel L. Altclass）。
制作人 D. S. Larby 转呈人 C Crawford 警督
关于附上的由一名叫塞缪尔·L·奥特拉斯的人致警务处处长的信函，此人为犹太裔，1915年5月13日出生于波兰华沙。
出生后一年内，奥特拉斯被父母带往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），全家在该地居住至第一次世界大战结束；战后，其居住地交替为哈尔滨和天津，后者是奥特拉斯接受教育的地方，其受教育程度似乎不高。
1931年，奥特拉斯在其母亲、兄弟和继父的陪同下离开天津前往上海，并自此居住于此。其继父名为利奥·鲁让斯基（Leo Roujansky），是一名失业推销员，在公共租界和法租界的警察队伍中均广为人知，是一名有多次定罪记录的臭名昭著的扒手。其兄弟鲍里斯·奥特拉斯（Boris Altclass）曾服役于上海万国商团，但在约两年前获得苏联国籍后辞职，返回俄国，目前在塔什干担任汽车机械师。
1932年，奥特拉斯成为爱文义路160号莱诺铸排机有限公司（Linotype & Machinery, Ltd.）的学徒，此后一直受雇于该公司；他目前担任工程部机械师，月薪75.00元。

    With regard to his knowledge of the printing trade in
all its aspects, Mr. H. Ellis, Manager of Linotype &
Machinery Ltd., has informed the undersigned that while
Altclass has an excellent knowledge of the engineering side
of the printing business, he cannot possess the abilities
implied in the attached letter.    Mr. Ellis intimated,
however, that if the services of a foreman mechanic were
required in the printing department of Ward Road Gaol, he
would have no hesitation in recommending Altclass for such
a position.
    During his residence in Shanghai, Altclass has taken
an active interest in sport, particularly Association
Football; nothing of a nature detrimental to his name is
contained in the records of the Municipal Police.

    关于他对印刷行业各方面知识的了解，莱诺铸排机有限公司经理 H. Ellis 先生告知下文签署人，虽然奥特拉斯对印刷业务的工程方面拥有极好的知识，但他并不具备附信中所暗示的能力。然而，Ellis 先生暗示，如果提篮桥监狱印刷部需要一名领班机械师，他将毫不犹豫地推荐奥特拉斯担任该职位。

Dea Sir,

I am taking the liberty of offering my
services to you in your C. I. D., as an inves-
tigator on printed newspaper and printed matters.
My reason for making this application is that I
understand that during the past several months
there came to your attention several cases for
investigation newspaper, magazines etc., which

I am a Jew, single, can read and write

D. 8371
1938年2月17日..

警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

我冒昧向您自荐，希望在您的刑事调查处（C. I. D.）担任报纸及印刷品调查员。我提出此申请的原因是，据我了解，在过去几个月里，贵处注意到几起涉及报纸、杂志等的调查案件，这些出版物对公共租界的福祉有害。这类工作需要具备识别字体、了解新闻印刷所用印刷机类型等知识的人员。

我是犹太人，单身，能读写俄语和英语。目前我是莱诺铸排机有限公司的雇员，已在该公司工作六年。我现年二十三岁。身体强壮健康，这对于上海公共租界警务处（S. M. P.）来说是必不可少的。

恳请您审阅此申请，并给予我一个证明我所提供服务价值的机会。

此致
敬礼

S. Altclass.

S. Altclass,
毕勋路64号
2号住宅，
上海。

DS. Manley
特别分部
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
